$comment: Full-featured DataGrid configuration template. Every top-level key populated with sensible defaults and per-field $comment annotations. INTENDED AS A REFERENCE, NOT A STARTING POINT — prefer entity-list-basic.json or entity-list-drill-through.json and add overrides only as needed (lean configs are good configs). REPLACE every placeholder marked with angle brackets. Type reference: src/client/shared/Spaarke.UI.Components/src/types/DataGridConfiguration.ts.

source.$comment: Discriminator 'type' picks one of three shapes: 'savedquery' (specific view by GUID — most common), 'savedquery-set' (auto-discover active savedqueries for the entity), or 'inline' (author FetchXML + layoutXml inline).
source.$comment_availableViews: R2 FR-05 — availableViews is an optional allowlist of sibling savedquery GUIDs shown in the ViewSelector dropdown. Empty array or omitted = no filter (all active sibling savedqueries visible). Precedence: per-instance overrides.availableViews from SectionInstance (FR-03) beats this config-level value.

display.$comment: Visual chrome overrides. All fields optional; each falls back to a framework or Power Apps OOB default.
display.title: <friendly-grid-title>
display.emptyStateMessage: No records match the current filters.

filterChips.$comment: How the filter chip strip above the grid is derived. mode='auto' (default) uses every chip-eligible layoutXml column. Use 'allowlist' / 'denylist' / 'explicit' to narrow.

commandBar.$comment: Command bar overrides. Omit any of the three keys to accept framework defaults. showDefaultCommands toggles the built-in buttons per slot.

primary.$comment: Custom primary command example. action='custom' requires customHandlerId which must be registered via registerCommandHandler in the host shell.
primary.label: Custom Action

rowOpen.$comment: What happens when the user clicks the primary-name link on a row. type='formDialog' opens the Dataverse-native centered modal (85% x 85%, Layout 1 — per R2 FR-20). Other types: sidePane, wizard, navigateToForm, dialog, webResource, custom.

secondaryActions.$comment: Per-row / bulk affordance. kind can be 'ai-assistant', 'playbook', 'wizard', 'navigate', or 'custom'. visible='row-hover' (default 'always') surfaces the button only on row hover.
secondaryActions.label: Run Playbook

columns.$comment: Per-column overrides keyed by logical name. Every field optional; omit any column to accept the framework's metadata-derived defaults.

behavior.$comment: Grid-level interaction knobs. pageSize default 25 (workspace-widget majority use case per FR-07 owner clarification 2026-07-02). Drill-through / full-page consumers should override to 50 or 100.

parentContextFilter.$comment: Optional parent-context filter overlay. Injects a top-level FetchXML condition at render time when parentContext[<parent-context-key>] is set on the host. attribute = CHILD entity's lookup back to parent. Delete this whole block for non-drill-through grids.
